inputs.name: DeploymentActivityService.progress.id
inputs.description: UUID assigned to the deployment plan and used as its activity key. An activity is returned only when this id exists and the supplied root also matches.

inputs.name: DeploymentActivityService.progress.root
inputs.description: Project root path stored with the scheduled deployment. A path mismatch makes progress return null.

inputs.name: DeploymentActivityService.wait.id
inputs.description: UUID of the deployment activity to await. An unknown or pruned id rejects with Error('Unknown deployment.').

inputs.name: DeploymentActivityService.ensureCapacity.count
inputs.description: Additional in-flight deployment slots to include in the capacity check. It defaults to 1 and throws when unfinished entries plus count exceeds 128; it does not validate integer or nonnegative values.

inputs.name: DeploymentActivityService.schedule.reviewed
inputs.description: Reviewed deployment record containing the plan, target, proof fingerprint, project/root context, and predecessor receipt. Scheduling uses its plan id, root, and target; a target must be present and the plan id must not already be registered.

inputs.name: DeploymentActivityService.schedule.work
inputs.description: Deployment callback invoked after the same-target queue predecessor and optional dependency settle. It receives a progress updater and optional predecessor receipt, must resolve to a DeploymentReceipt, and its rejection fails the activity and is rethrown by wait.

inputs.name: DeploymentActivityService.schedule.dependency
inputs.description: Optional promise for a required lower-environment receipt that schedule awaits before invoking work. It has no source default; a rejection becomes Error('A required lower-environment deployment failed.').

outputs.name: DeploymentActivityService.list
outputs.description: Returns cloned DeploymentActivity records in reverse registration order, newest scheduled first. Pruning retains at most the 64 most recently finished entries in addition to unfinished entries.

outputs.name: DeploymentActivityService.progress
outputs.description: Returns a cloned DeploymentActivity when the id exists and its stored project root matches, or null otherwise. The record may change phase as scheduled work proceeds.

outputs.name: DeploymentActivityService.wait
outputs.description: Returns the registered completion promise, which resolves to its DeploymentReceipt. It rejects for an unknown id or when the scheduled dependency or work fails.

outputs.name: DeploymentActivityService.idle
outputs.description: Returns a promise that resolves after all completion promises present at invocation settle. It uses Promise.allSettled, so deployment failures do not reject idle.

outputs.name: DeploymentActivityService.ensureCapacity
outputs.description: Returns undefined when unfinished entries plus count is at most 128. It throws Error('Wait for queued deployments before starting more.') when that sum exceeds 128.

outputs.name: DeploymentActivityService.schedule
outputs.description: Registers work and returns a cloned activity in its initial queued state. Work is serialized for a matching adapter, target kind, account id, and target name, with the branch included for Pages targets.

outputs.name: desktopDeployments
outputs.description: The exported host-wide DeploymentActivityService singleton that owns the activity entries and per-target queue tails.

errors.name: DeploymentAlreadyStartedError
errors.description: A deployment with the same plan ID is already registered.

errors.name: DeploymentCapacityError
errors.description: Scheduling would take the number of unfinished deployments beyond 128.

errors.name: MissingDeploymentTargetError
errors.description: The reviewed deployment has no target.

errors.name: RequiredLowerEnvironmentDeploymentError
errors.description: A required lower-environment deployment rejected before this deployment started.

errors.name: UnknownDeploymentError
errors.description: wait rejects when no deployment is registered with the supplied ID.

errors.name: Deployment work rejection
errors.description: For a registered deployment the underlying work rejection propagates without conversion.
